question:
Select the most appropriate synonym for the given word.

Relinquish
solution:
The correct answer is: **Surrender**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Relinquish"** means to voluntarily give up or let go of something, often a possession, right, or claim. (त्याग करना, छोड़ देना)

 
 
• **Example: **She decided to relinquish her position as the team leader to focus on personal goals.
 
 
 
• **"Surrender"** refers to giving up control or possession of something, often to someone else or under compulsion. (आत्मसमर्पण करना, छोड़ देना)
 
 
• **Example: **The soldiers had no choice but to surrender to the enemy forces after running out of supplies.
 
 
 
• Hence, the synonym of **'Relinquish'** is **'Surrender'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Surrender**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Embrace** (गले लगाना, स्वीकार करना): To accept or support something willingly or enthusiastically.

 
 
• **Example:** She decided to embrace the challenges that come with starting a new business.
 
 
 
• **Hold** (पकड़ना): To keep or maintain possession of something.
 
 
• **Example: **He held the book tightly in his hands.
 
 
 
• **Retain** (बनाए रखना): To continue to have or keep something.
 
 
• **Example:** The organization has been able to retain most of its employees despite the economic downturn.
 
 

39:Td7a,
The correct answer is **Option 3**.
